summary: Amber International Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a pro rata distribution of its Class A ordinary shares by principal shareholder Amber Global Limited (AGL) to AGL's shareholders. AGL held 309,834,748 Class A shares; no price, premium, or new shares are involved. The board authorized the distribution, expected to close on June 1, 2026. No consideration or fee is specified. The distribution is non-dilutive and shares will be restricted under the Securities Act. The registrant is merely an issuer filing a current report on a shareholder event; no special-situation M&A or restructuring is present.
